profile: UroGen Pharma develops and commercializes treatments for urothelial and specialty cancers. Its approved products, Jelmyto and Zusduri, combine mitomycin with its RTGel sustained-release hydrogel for local delivery in the upper urinary tract or bladder. Jelmyto is used to treat low-grade upper tract urothelial cancer, while Zusduri treats recurrent low-grade intermediate-risk non-muscle-invasive bladder cancer. The company also has an investigational oncolytic virus in its pipeline.
